   and false);

        Order valid for 3 bars;

        Replacing pending orders: allowed; 
        Stop Loss = StopLossCoef1 * ATR(95);
        Profit target = ProfitTargetCoef1 * ATR(95);

        Trailing Stop = TrailingStopCoef1 * ATR(34);

        Exit After ExitAfterBars1 bars;
}
